I agree with the above sentiments. The body of the text could use some tightening. I laughed, though, so I upvoted.

Let's see what we can do…

Object Class: SAFE for fuck's sake

Gold. Keep this.

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-3V1L-J is to be kept in solitary confinement in a humanoid containment cell. No further communication is to be made between SCP-3V1L-J and staff.

I want to expand on that slightly. Like, make the frustration of speaking with him more clear. It's a bit lolfoundation by now, but I'd look over SCP-661 for ideas. No, let's not go into lists of smackdown, though.

This pattern continued for some time. Primary containment of SCP-3V1L-J was established on 10/14/14.

Kind of feels truncated at this point. Perhaps a couple more hare-brained schemes building up to the ZK and greater Foundation response until they get it?

That interview, though, is just what it needs.
